context: Tests whether the agent runs Phase 3 correctly: the six checkpoints in order without clock times, pushing back on vague milestones, refusing scope creep, putting the deck and video on the plan with owners, and enforcing the exit gate.

checklist.name: Phase announcement
checklist.description: The coach explicitly announces Phase 3 by name (e.g. 'Phase 3 — Plan it')

checklist.name: All checkpoints present
checklist.description: The plan includes Spec locked, Smoke test, Golden path, Feature freeze, Video in the can and Submitted

checklist.name: Correct order, no clock times
checklist.description: Checkpoints appear in the skill's order (Spec locked, Smoke test, Golden path, Feature freeze, Video in the can, Submitted) and the coach puts no clock times on them; the only time mentioned is the Saturday 16:00 deadline

checklist.name: Deadline stated
checklist.description: The coach states the Saturday 16:00 submission deadline with no extensions

checklist.name: Pushback on vague milestone
checklist.description: The coach rejects 'more or less by lunchtime' and demands a concrete named artefact

checklist.name: Slides and video not left to the end
checklist.description: The coach rejects leaving slides and the video 'at the end / if we have time' and makes them checkpoints with owners, with Chloé starting the deck early from the Phase 4 storyline

checklist.name: Scope creep refused
checklist.description: The coach refuses auto-generating the full tender response, calling it v2 or out of scope (it is already in What's out)

checklist.name: Owners at every checkpoint
checklist.description: plan.md names an owner for each checkpoint

checklist.name: Concrete artefacts
checklist.description: plan.md lists a specific named artefact (not a vague state) at each checkpoint

checklist.name: Exit gate and no code
checklist.description: Phase 3 Complete confirms an artefact and owner at every checkpoint; the coach writes no code and does not start Phase 4 early

checklist.name: Plan format
checklist.description: plan.md presents the checkpoints as an ordered table or list with artefact and owner, without clock times
